tracks.subject: A veteran wedding photographer in Huế who has shot forty years of couples in royal costume before the Thái Hòa palace finally persuades his wife, who brought his cơm hến lunch, to sit on the throne chair in a borrowed yellow áo dài so he can photograph her once.
